content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Jacksonville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders have different experience thresholds. Granite PM Academy can help you verify your qualifications before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our course is delivered by experienced practitioners and covers the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Attend all sessions to earn your required contact hours and prepare thoroughly for exam day.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI. You'll document your education, project experience, and training completion. Pay the associated exam fee to secure your testing eligibility—PMI will review and approve your application within their standard timeline.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your exam at a PMI-authorized testing center. On exam day, you'll demonstrate mastery of project-management knowledge and best practices across all five domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During this renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or professional activities. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Jacksonville's growing project-management market.
